text:
tess_pm: Quick sync — customer 'Orchid' filed two must-haves: stable outbound IPs for webhook allowlists and upgrades that never drop webhook delivery. Need a short decision for Q2 scope.

dev_lin: Two engineering approaches: 1) Document required customer static-egress + build preflight checks (low work). 2) Build an optional managed egress component (operator) we install in-customer that provides stable IPs (higher work, more control).

sam_net: Networking reality: managed-egress can implement a floating VIP or advertise prefixes via BGP. VIP is simpler but depends on tenant network supporting VIPs. BGP is robust but most customers avoid routing config.

ria_field: Field color: customers hate extra appliances but also hate touching routing. Many will accept an opt-in "we run the egress" if it's a small footprint and we provide tooling.

mira_design: Installer UX idea: show two clear choices with short bullets: "assume customer static egress (fast)" and "managed egress (opt-in, recommended for webhooks)". Also surface maintenance expectations when picking managed.

alex_sales: Commercial note: customers will pay for managed-egress+SLA. We should ship alpha without SLA and gate paid SLA to GA after canaries. I'll draft addendum language.

dev_lin: For zero-drop upgrades in managed-egress mode, we need upgrade choreography: keep N replicas, failover VIP then patch instance, synthetic replay checks, and a sequencer that ensures at-least-once delivery to webhooks during rotation.

sam_net: Preflight checks must include outbound IP echo, firewall/egress rule checks, and a synthetic webhook ping that returns source IP. If any fail, installer should block and give remediation steps.

tess_pm: Proposal: Q2 MVP = installer preflight + UX + docs for "customer-static" path, plus an alpha managed-egress operator (no SLA) with runbook and canary plan. GA SLA work in Q3. Agree?

ria_field: Agree — field can run first canaries. Need a rollback threshold: if webhook error rate >0.5% within 30m, auto-revert.

mira_design: I'll mock the installer screens and inline tooltip about maintenance windows (5-15 min per node in IP-preserve mode).

dev_lin: Estimates: preflight + UX + docs = 1.5 eng-weeks. Managed-egress alpha (operator, VIP failover, probes) = 5 eng-weeks + 1 SRE-week for canaries.

alex_sales: I'll coordinate contract language and pricing tiers (self-managed vs managed-with-SLA).

ci-bot: CI job #991 starting for branch feat/egress-operator — tests queued.

tess_pm: Action items: dev_lin -> tech spec for managed-egress alpha (Tue). sam_net -> preflight checklist + CLI verifier (Wed). mira_design -> installer mocks (Thu). alex_sales -> addendum draft (Fri). ria_field -> recruit 2 canary customers (Fri). I'll update roadmap once specs land.

end.
